text:
maya.design: Quick design pass on the playground run detail — tool call results feel visually cramped and we lose the schema context when skimming. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/test-snip.png :eyes:

jordan.devex: Agree. Current layout buries the function return schema. Proposal: show a compact schema pill above each tool output that's collapsible. Keyboard focusable, small chevron to expand full schema.

leo.product: Concern: adding a pill for every tool might push down primary content for long outputs. Could we collapse by default and only expand on hover/focus? Or show a 1-line summary + "Show schema" control.

olivia.a11y: VoiceOver notes: pills alone aren't discoverable. We need an accessible control with role="button", aria-expanded, and aria-controls to reveal the schema panel. Also ensure the expanded panel receives focus and we restore focus after close. Avoid relying on hover for discoverability (touch+keyboard).

sam.runtime: From runtime side: we can attach a small `schema_fingerprint` to each invocation response so the client can show the pill without extra lookups. Also we can compute a quick mismatch status server-side to add a red/yellow indicator if output deviates.

jordan.devex: Nice — with `schema_fingerprint` we can also fetch a cached compact schema blob. UX idea: pill shows name + mini-icon: ✅/⚠️/❌ for match/warn/fail. Click expands full schema with example diffs.

maya.design: Copy thought: for mismatch state we currently say "Schema mismatch" — too terse. Draft copy: "Output doesn't match the expected schema — review sample outputs or open JSON view." Shorter alternatives welcome.

leo.product: +1 for clearer call to action. Maybe: "Output differs from expected shape — view samples or open JSON." Keep the CTA verbs consistent.

olivia.a11y: Please avoid the word "raw" as a label. Screen readers read it odd. Use "Show JSON" or "Open JSON view". Also add title text for the pill like "Schema: OrderV2" so screen readers can pick it up in the run list.

sam.runtime: We can also emit a short validation snippet in metadata like: `{"missing_fields": ["price"], "extra_fields": ["discount_code"]}` — client can render a concise sentence: "Missing: price; Extra: discount_code". Keep that collapsible.

jordan.devex: UX nit on run history: add a filter toggle to only show runs with schema mismatches. That'd speed up debugging for QA. Should be backend-filterable with a query `status=validation_error`.

maya.design: Interaction flow sketch: pill collapsed shows [SchemaName][⚠️]. On focus Enter or Cmd/Ctrl+I opens a right-side inspector with full schema, examples, and a small "jump to run" link. Keyboard: support Enter to expand, Esc to close.

olivia.a11y: Add an accessible shortcut hint inside the pill tooltip: "Press Cmd+I to open inspector" and expose that shortcut in the keyboard help modal. Also ensure color isn't the only signal for status.

ci-bot: CI: automatic visual diff job queued for playground-run-detail v4.2.3 — /deploy-notes attached.

maya.design: OK next steps: jordan to mock the pill + inspector states in Figma; sam to add `schema_fingerprint` + validation metadata to the invocations API; olivia to review aria labels; leo to confirm product priority. Ping back here when sketches are up. :sparkles:
